summary: Zitron argues that AI spending far outstrips its value, that LLMs suit only small supervised tasks, and that companies should answer for harms.

statements.quote: LLMs do not have to be conscious or powerful AI to be incredibly dangerous.
statements.venue: Where’s Your Ed At, AI Is Already In Dangerous Hands

statements.quote: There is nothing ‘anti-progress’ about opposing AI data centers, and nobody has a compelling explanation as to why we need more of them.
statements.venue: Where’s Your Ed At, Hyperscale Normalization

statements.quote: There is no AGI coming. There is no conscious computer.
statements.venue: Where’s Your Ed At, The AI Hater’s Manifesto

statements.quote: Nothing about LLMs is worth a trillion dollars, or even $100 billion.
statements.venue: Where’s Your Ed At, The AI Hater’s Manifesto

statements.quote: As a way of speeding up small units of work in ways that are manageable both technically and cognitively, LLMs can be useful.
